title: OSX Rename Failure
body:
> What is your rclone version (eg output from `rclone -V`)
rclone v1.35-62-g9d331ceβ

> Which OS you are using and how many bits (eg Windows 7, 64 bit)

> Which cloud storage system are you using? (eg Google Drive)
Amazon Cloud Drive

> The command you were trying to run (eg `rclone copy /tmp remote:tmp`)

```
2017/02/03 13:21:18 Media/Unsorted/X-Men X2 X-Men United (2003) [1080p] {5.1}: Dir.Lookup

2017/02/03 13:21:18 amazon drive root 'Vault': Finished reading "dmi0e2fbj6btggkj33t5dtqmo4/kerbir1jjej6g0nbqq716m0bo0/nqh00jdqfppsht0etjfonv6orct68e2hptv9q6ja6kf3lro0mq48utj5r30lhki4fmgcis0nic0js/"
2017/02/03 13:21:18 Media/Movies/X-Men X2 X-Men United (2003) [1080p] {5.1}: Dir.Rename can't rename non empty directory
```

It seems that even on linux, the mv command on mounted filesystems isn't using the rename functionality behind the scenes, but rather is actually moving the bits. Is that accurate / intended?
